name: trace.neighbourhood
title: Show neighbourhood
summary: The elements reached from one element over its relations and inline references, of every relation kind, up and down to a depth; each edge says whether it repeats an element and whether it is outdated. One page of nodes at a time.

ref.description: The element whose relations and references are walked.

repository.description: The workspace name of the repository of the element ref names, as in element.get (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#255).

direction.description: `up`: along the relations and references the element's file stores (its parents, the targets of its other relations and relation properties, its inline references). `down`: along the relations and references that point at it (its children and every element whose file has a relation or an inline reference to it). The source of a relation or reference is placed below its target (ADR-0004).

maxDepth.description: The deepest depth in each direction; 0: the root only. Omitted: 1 (the direct neighbours), unless `allLevels` is true.

allLevels.description: Walk as far as the relations and references go (the whole chain); not together with `maxDepth`. For the chain alone ask with `meanings: ["derivation"]`.

kinds.description: Keys of relation kinds or of properties of kind `relation` (such as `packages`) to follow. An unknown key is `input.invalid`. See `meanings` for the filter rule.

meanings.description: Relation kinds with these meanings are followed; `reference` stands for inline references. Without `kinds` and `meanings` every relation and reference is followed. Otherwise a relation or reference is followed when its key is in `kinds` or its meaning is in `meanings`; an empty list follows nothing.

view.description: Only the elements reached that this view holds: `core` or a variant ID; without it every element.

limit.description: Nodes of the page; total counts all.

offset.description: Nodes skipped before the page, in the order of `nodes` (the root, the up walk level by level, the down walk level by level).

nodes.description: Every element reached once per walk, at its shortest depth: the root, then the up walk, then the down walk, each level by level. In a view only the elements the view holds (SR-040, SR-043: not a core requirement the variant excludes or replaces); the root always. Only the page of `limit` nodes from `offset` is listed; `total` counts all.

identifier.description: Its identifier (the value of its property with the meaning `identifier`, such as SR-036, ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#305), for display next to `shortId`; left out when it has none.

status.description: Its status key as written; left out when it has none.

repository.description: Workspace name of the repository of its file.

depth.description: Steps from the root in its walk: 0 for the root.

direction.description: `up` for an element reached along the relations and references its file stores, `down` for one reached along those that point at it; left out for the root.

expanded.description: Its relations and references were looked at; false only at `maxDepth`, where the walk was cut.

total.description: The number of all nodes; `nodes` holds the page.

edges.description: Every relation and reference the walks followed, up edges first, then down edges, in walk order; an edge is on the page of the node it leads to in its walk. A hub (a package with many members) can put many edges on one page: leave out `packages` with `kinds` or `meanings`. Not listed: unresolved relations and references (`element.get` and `workspace.check` report them).

source.description: The element whose file stores the relation or reference.

sourceRepository.description: Workspace name of the repository of `source`.

target.description: The element the relation or reference points at (ADR-0004), whatever the walk direction.

targetRepository.description: Workspace name of the repository of `target`.

link.description: A relation in the frontmatter or an inline reference in the text or in a property marked `markdown`.

kind.description: The frontmatter key, only for `link: relation`.

property.description: The key is a property of kind `relation` (such as `packages`), not a relation kind.

meaning.description: The meaning of the relation kind, `reference` for an inline reference; left out for a kind without a meaning and for a property.

cyclic.description: Both ends lie in one cycle of the walk.

repeated.description: The edge leads, in its walk, to an element that this walk first reached through another edge, or to the root: a repetition (SR-107 AK3). It holds within one call (asking again from a child loses it; to open a tree level by level ask from the same root with a larger `maxDepth`) and within the followed kinds (the tree of derivations comes from `meanings: ["derivation"]`). First means first reached breadth first (spec question ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#421).

outdated.description: The relation or reference stores a version of normal form 1 or 2, its target is available and has a current version, and the two differ, compared in the stored version's form (SR-025, ADR-0005).
